_about: Synthetic sample profiles for the demo. These are invented people: no real personal data or real CVs are used, as the SDC Domain 1 rules require. Skill levels: 1 basic, 2 working, 3 strong.

personas.name: Aisyah
personas.headline: Customer service agent, 12 years at a bank call centre
personas.story: Her bank has just launched an AI chatbot for routine questions. Her team shrank this year and she wants to know what to learn next — with only evenings free.

personas.name: Daniel
personas.headline: Fresh accounting graduate, first job search
personas.story: He keeps reading that AI will replace accountants. He wants a path that uses his degree, is safe whether AI moves slowly or fast, and helps on climate.

personas.name: Mei Ling
personas.headline: Administrative assistant, 18 years at a Penang manufacturer
personas.story: Her company is automating invoicing and scheduling. She is trusted, organised and speaks three languages, and wants to stay with the firm in a new role.

personas.name: Farid
personas.headline: IT support technician, 5 years at an SME
personas.story: AI assistants now answer half the helpdesk tickets. He likes security work and wants to know which move is realistic in the next year.
